preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(name, str) for name in names)
preconditions.description: Each element in the input list is a string representing a common bird name.
Each bird name contains at least one word.

postconditions.description: The length of the returned array is the same as the length of the input array.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(code, str) and len(code) == 4 and code.isupper() for code in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each code in the returned array is a string of exactly four uppercase letters.
